## Summary

Implements the normative Determinism and Authority Contract requested after PR #85.

### Implemented

- Formal `F(State, Block) = State'` determinism invariant.
- Canonical input/type/encoding/commitment contract.
- Layer-by-layer determinism responsibilities and forbidden authority.
- WHO / WHAT / WHERE enforcement model.
- Canonical Integrity → Authenticity/Authorization → Validity → Ordering → Consensus → Execution → State Transition → Commitment → Finality chain.
- Six machine-readable P0 contracts:
  - P0-NET-001 Network / P2P
  - P0-ID-001 Identity / Trust
  - P0-STATE-001 State Ownership
  - P0-AUTH-001 Global Authority Matrix
  - P0-IF-001 Canonical Interfaces
  - P0-FR-001 Failure / Recovery
- Human-readable P0 contract alignment.
- Exact-SHA evidence trail and fail-closed verification requirements.
- Preserves component repositories as implementation SSOTs.

### Existing-First

PR #85 / Source-SHA `2ed57aeca0259362e4ab159cf219fed7934833f4` was used as the architectural baseline. The existing `control-plane/` and `docs/architecture/` structures were inspected before adding new contract artifacts. No duplicate architecture document was introduced.

### Evidence boundary

This PR implements ecosystem-level normative contracts and machine-readable specifications. It does not claim that component implementations already satisfy these contracts. Component compliance remains subject to exact Source-SHA evidence.
